App details

Workout / Training

Follow expert-designed exercise programs and keep a record of your training.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Training guidance for beginners, people returning to exercise and gym users, supported by a training diary and personal records. Programs and exercise demonstrations will need specialist review; the starting selection is still being prepared.

Main features

  • Exercise demonstrations and equipment guidance.
  • Record sets, repetitions, weight and duration.
  • Rest timer, training history and personal records.
  • Use downloaded training modules offline.

This app is being planned and is not yet available to download. The description presents its intended functions.

Features in detail

Expert guidance and your training log

Expert programs and exercise guidance

The planned entry paths are complete beginner, sedentary lifestyle, returning to training, first gym visit, learning machines and home training. Search exercises by equipment or category and read setup, posture, execution, breathing, common mistakes and demonstration. Launch programs, exercise categories and free/paid content selection still need expert preparation; no named program is offered as ready here.

Follow a workout and log what you did

Open the program’s ordered workout, start a session and record sets, repetitions, weight in kg/lb or duration for timed exercises. Your actual performance can differ from the plan. Mark completion for a summary; abandoning or skipping is not completed training. Optional short notes accompany exercises without editing the expert instructions.

Rest timing, screen and reminders

The program supplies rest timing where appropriate. Pause, reset or skip the timer, with optional sound/vibration. Keep the screen awake while following instructions if useful. Opt into a chosen training reminder day/time; turn it off anytime, and notification denial leaves training available.

History, progress and four personal records

Review completed workouts by date, duration, exercises and set/repetition/weight summary; delete history explicitly. Progress shows completed versus planned workouts and relevant volume from weight×repetitions. Four record types are highest weight, most repetitions at the same weight, highest set volume and longest timed duration. These report your log, not a medical or coaching judgment.

Download, offline use and content updates

Check a module’s expected size before download. Installed instructions and demonstrations work offline. Remove local content to free space while keeping your purchase access, then download again. Expert-corrected material can be updated without rewriting old workout records. Switch or restart a program while retaining earlier history.

Ad-free app and separate one-time modules

The planned app is ad-free with a free expert/educational base and separately purchased expert modules. Each module is a one-time purchase with lasting access, not a subscription or time rental. The actual local price comes from Play when a module is available. Restore purchases after reinstall/device change; voluntary support does not unlock modules. The initial free and paid catalogue still needs expert selection.

Local logs, readable export and backup

Keep workout history, progress and notes on your device without a mandatory account. Export a readable summary or create an offline backup and restore validated user data; purchase access is restored separately through Play. Age, body weight and health details are not mandatory just to use the base app. This is a fitness aid, not diagnosis.

A playful transformation in About

Tap the About logo seven times for a short, roughly 4–5-second cartoon: a slim figure lifts a dumbbell, grows exaggerated muscles and bursts its shirt. It is a visual joke, not a claim about real training results. The scene works offline, can be closed and never changes your program or workout log; reduced motion uses still poses.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
